description: A canister from the Lowvents, still warm, smelling of wet coal. Inside, in pencil, on the back of a coal docket: "Twenty Brass Ingots. Vent sleeves. The Fellowship will remember. Ash." There is no please and no thank you. Mother Ash does not repeat herself, and does not, it seems, begin.

options.label: Send twenty Brass Ingots down to the Fellowship hall.

success.text: The ingots go down the tube in four loads, each one landing in the Lowvents with a noise you can hear from Sprocket Row. No reply comes. Two days later a Stoker you do not know holds a door for you on the long stair, and that, you understand, is the reply.

options.label: Write back on the docket that you have none to spare this week.

success.text: The answer comes back on the same coal docket, turned over: "Noted." It is one word, and Mother Ash has managed to make it sound like a ledger entry.
